XYZ company,a manufacturer of chairs, had the following data for 2023: (5x4)   
Sales2400 units =20   
Sales price600 Tk per unit   
Variable costs150 Tk per unit   
Fixed costs20,000   
Instructions: compute-  
(i) What is the contribution margin ratio?   
(ii) What is the break-even point in units and sales?   
(iii) What is the margin of safety in units and sales?   
(iv) If the companywishes to increase its contribution margin by 40% in 2024,   
by how much will it need toincrease its sales if allother factors remain   
constant?
